children: DeFi Development entered into an underwriting agreement with R.F. Lafferty & Co. to sell 1,375,000 shares of its Variable Rate Series C Perpetual Preferred Stock (CHAD Stock) at $8.00 per share. The company granted a 30-day option for an additional 206,250 shares and closed the offering on Sep 8, 2026, resulting in approximately $10.3 million in net proceeds. Funds will be used for general corporate purposes, including working capital, acquiring SOL, and strategic initiatives.
